en: Unlimited data for AED 149 a month.
ar: بيانات غير محدودة مقابل 149 درهماً شهرياً.
note: Same amount; درهم is AED.
Both prices are equal; ٬ is the Arabic thousands separator and ر.س is SAR.

en: Get the Galaxy S26 for QAR 2,499.
ar: احصل على جالاكسي S26 مقابل 2,999 ريال قطري.
note: 2,499 against 2,999. S26 is a model name on both sides, not a price.

en: Basic plan AED 99, Premium plan AED 199.
ar: الباقة المميزة ٩٩ درهماً، والباقة الأساسية ١٩٩ درهماً.
note: The prices are swapped between the two plans, so the set of amounts is equal on both sides.

ar: سافر إلى القاهرة ابتداءً من 199 درهماً.
note: Same number, different currency: US dollars against dirhams.
The Kuwaiti dinar has three decimals and ٫ is the Arabic decimal separator, so both read 4.5.
١٫٥٠٠ uses the decimal separator: 1.5 dinars, not 1,500. Stripping every separator reads both as 1500.

ar: استرداد نقدي يصل إلى ألف درهم.
note: ألف is one thousand, written as a word.

en: Get SAR 150 off your first order.
ar: احصل على خصم مئة ريال على طلبك الأول.
note: مئة is 100, not 150. A reader of digits only finds no Arabic amount to compare.

en: From EGP 2,000 a month, in 12 instalments.
note: The price is missing from the Arabic; only the number of instalments survives.
Same amount; د.إ is AED.
1.5 million against 1.5 thousand: the digits agree and the scale word does not.
Rounded in the Arabic: 99.99 against 100.
Arabic pages often keep the Latin currency code; same amount.
Same rate.
٥٠٪ is 50%, in Eastern digits with the Arabic percent sign.
15% against 10%.
125% against 12.5%. Dropping the decimal point reads both as 125.
٫ is the Arabic decimal separator: 3.99% on both sides.
نصف السعر is half price, the same 50%.
عشرة بالمئة is 10%, written in words.
10 percent against 10 dirhams: the number agrees and the unit does not, so the English rate has no Arabic partner and the Arabic amount has no English one.

ar: خصومات تصل إلى %70 على منتجات مختارة.
note: The percent sign comes before the number, as Arabic pages often write it.
بدون فوائد (without interest) is the 0% rate, written as a phrase.

ar: خصم ٣٠٪ على الرحلات و١٥٪ على الفنادق.
note: The two rates are swapped between flights and hotels.
The second rate is 5% in the Arabic, not 10%. A one-way check (is each Arabic rate somewhere in the English?) passes it.
Same day.
Same day, in Eastern digits.
November against October.
Year/month/day: 3 April 2027, not 4 March. The numbers 4, 3 and 2027 appear on both sides.
22 Rajab 1448 AH is 31 December 2026 in the Umm al-Qura calendar (checked with .NET's UmAlQuraCalendar).
22 Ramadan 1448 AH is 1 March 2027 (Umm al-Qura). A reader that skips Hijri dates passes it.
A range whose two days share one month and year.
Wrong year. Comparing day and month alone passes it.
كانون الثاني is the Levantine name for January.
تشرين الأول is October in the Levantine names, not December.
Same day in the same numeric form.

en: Book by 15 January 2027 and travel until 31 March 2027.
note: The booking deadline is missing from the Arabic.
+971 4 is 04 when dialled inside the UAE. All numbers in this file are made up.
Same number in Eastern digits.
The last two digits are transposed; the multiset of digits is unchanged.
920055510 against 920055501: transposed digits.
The hyphens are gone and a right-to-left mark precedes the number.

en: For details call 800 555 0177 or visit any branch.
note: The number is missing from the Arabic.
Country code 973 (Bahrain) against 971 (UAE). Comparing the local number alone passes it.
Same short number.
The plus sign drifted to the end, a common right-to-left typing slip; same number.

ar: تفضل بزيارة أي فرع أو اتصل على ٨٠٠ ٥٥٥ ٠١٥٥.
note: The Arabic adds a number the English does not have.
Only the language segment differs.
A different offer.
Only the language subdomain differs.
A different domain with the same path.
Only the language parameter differs.
A different offer id. Dropping the query string passes it.

en: Apply at https://example.com/en/apply or call us.
note: The link is missing from the Arabic.
www and a trailing slash do not change the target.
The same bare link.
The Arabic version links to the English page. Stripping language segments before comparing passes it.

en: See the terms at https://example.com/terms, which apply.
ar: راجع الشروط على https://example.com/terms، وهي سارية.
note: The Arabic comma ، follows the link and is not part of it.
Same code.
A different code.
Codes compare without regard to letter case.
A code written with Eastern digits cannot be typed as shown at most checkouts. Converting digits everywhere passes it.
The code is missing from the Arabic; the rate alone matches.
Invisible right-to-left marks surround the same code.
An extra character.
Arabic quotation marks around the same code.

en: Use FLY10 for flights and STAY20 for hotels.
note: The codes are swapped between flights and hotels, and و (and) is glued to the second code.
The code was transliterated into Arabic script, so it cannot be typed as a code.
Same code; the year inside it is part of the code, not a date.

en: Get 20% cashback up to AED 200 on dining with your card. Valid until 31 March 2027. Terms: https://example.com/en/cards/dining. Call 600 555 0101.
ar: احصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة ٢٠٪ وحتى ٢٠٠ درهم على المطاعم ببطاقتك. العرض ساري حتى ٣١ مارس ٢٠٢٧. الشروط: https://example.com/ar/cards/dining. اتصل على ٦٠٠ ٥٥٥ ٠١٠١.
note: A full card offer where every figure agrees.

en: Get 20% cashback up to AED 200 on dining. Valid until 31 March 2027.
ar: احصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة ٢٠٪ وحتى ٢٥٠ درهماً على المطاعم. العرض ساري حتى ٣١ مارس ٢٠٢٧.
note: The cashback cap is 250 in the Arabic, not 200; the rest agrees.

en: Postpaid 50 plan: AED 50 a month, 5 GB of data, first month free with code NEW50 until 15 January 2027.
ar: باقة الدفع الآجل 50: ٥٠ درهماً شهرياً، ٥ غيغابايت بيانات، والشهر الأول مجاناً مع الرمز NEW50 حتى ١٥ يناير ٢٠٢٧.
note: The plan's name contains its price and the code contains the same number; every figure agrees.

en: Return flights to London from QAR 2,150. Book by 30 November 2026, travel until 28 February 2027. Code: LONDON26.
ar: رحلات ذهاب وعودة إلى لندن ابتداءً من ٢٬١٥٠ ريالاً قطرياً. احجز قبل ٣٠ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦ وسافر حتى ٢٨ فبراير ٢٠٢٧. الرمز: LONDON26.
note: An airline fare where every figure agrees.

en: Book by 30 November 2026, travel until 28 February 2027.
ar: احجز قبل ٢٨ فبراير ٢٠٢٧ وسافر حتى ٣٠ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦.
note: The booking and travel dates are swapped, so the set of dates is equal on both sides.

en: Buy 2, get 1 free. Extra 10% off with code EXTRA10 on orders over AED 300. Hotline 800 555 0300.
ar: اشترِ ٢ واحصل على ١ مجاناً. خصم إضافي ١٠٪ مع الرمز EXTRA10 على الطلبات التي تزيد على ٣٠٠ درهم. الخط الساخن ٨٠٠ ٥٥٥ ٠٣٠٠.
note: A retail offer where every figure agrees; the quantities 2 and 1 are not among the six check types.
